title: John Rogers - The Power of Patience

reader_summary.headline: John Rogers isn't just a successful investor; he's an industry titan.
reader_summary.overview: John Rogers isn't just a successful investor; he's an industry titan. As the founder of a reputable investment firm, he's made a name for himself with his contrarian value investing strategies. But he's not just a practitioner; he's an educator, avidly reading and contributing to seminal works in investment literature.

key_points.text: John's journey began with an early fascination for finance from his youthful days.
In today's episode, John joins us to discuss his formative experiences, the philosophical underpinning of his investment strategy, and the importance of thinking long-term.
